description:
There’s a WHOLE CASTLE for Sale In Texas… And I Got Inside. This $15 Million Texas Castle Blew My Mind! 
Did you know there’s a real $15 Million castle hidden in the heart of Texas Hill Country? 🏰✨
In this video, I’m taking you on a full tour of Falkenstein Castle — a 14,000 sq ft masterpiece sitting on 110 acres in Burnet, Texas. From grand halls, imported European artifacts, authentic knights' armor, and a chapel straight out of a fairytale… this place is beyond anything you’ve seen in Texas real estate.

Whether you're into unique properties, luxury homes, or just love a good castle tour — this one's for you.

📍 Falkenstein Castle, Burnet, TX
💰 Listed at $15,000,000
🎥 Full walk-through of every stunning detail
Want a private tour or more details?
👉 Link in description | Contact info below

Big thanks to Kyle Stevens, the listing agent, for letting us showcase this unbelievable property.

👇 Drop a comment and let me know…
Would you live in a Texas castle?
